plugin.name: mercadopago
plugin.description: Mercado Pago full-product integration toolkit for Codex. AGENTS.md routes to four orchestration skills (mp-integrate, mp-webhooks, mp-test-setup, mp-review). Scaffolding works without MCP auth; live docs, credential lookup, and test-user creation require the official Mercado Pago MCP server.
plugin.author: Mercado Pago Developer Experience

components.name: mp-integrate
components.description: Wizard that scaffolds a complete Mercado Pago integration from official and bundled sources, using MCP only for selected account actions or documentation gaps. Use whenever the developer wants to add or migrate a Mercado Pago payment flow.

components.name: mp-review
components.description: Review a Mercado Pago integration with a local cross-cutting security checklist and official MCP quality tools on demand. Use after the integration is in place, or when the `mp-review` skill is invoked.

components.name: mp-test-setup
components.description: Create test users and add funds to them for Mercado Pago testing. Wraps create_test_user and add_money_test_user from the MCP. Clarifies that credentials come in APP_USR- (Orders API, Checkout Pro, Point, QR) and TEST- (Checkout API, Bricks, Payments API) formats — both are valid and actively issued.

components.name: mp-webhooks
components.description: Configure and validate Mercado Pago webhooks. Wraps the MCP webhook tools (save_webhook, notifications_history) and provides the HMAC-SHA256 signature validation pattern that every receiver must implement. Use when adding, debugging, or hardening notification handling.
